text: ①ならびかえ　を　したい　ポケモンを　えらびます。

structure.jp: ①ならびかえ　を　したい　ポケモンを
structure.en: ① the Pokémon you want to reorder

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it. ならびかえ　を　したい = 'want to do a reorder'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ならびかえ　を　したい　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing tells you which thing. ならびかえ　を　したい　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you want to reorder'.
